Rows 4-9 are a flat cushion or panel face with vertical seams and highlight lines at rows 4 and 9. Rows 10-14 are a dark band, a brown apron and a grey base, all vertical. No seat surface is visible from above, so this matches the 'front elevation' and 'band 2' wrong examples.

styleAnswer.evidence: The candidate is a wide wooden seat built from horizontal slats, with a tinted dark red-brown outline. 0% of its dark edge pixels are neutral, so it avoids the near-black sticker line, and the same 0% appears on the hedge reference. Flat-fill coverage is 0%, and the median of 10 colours per tile equals the hedge reference. Each slat has a highlight edge, a mid tone and a dark gap, giving about 4 steps against 5-6 on the bench and the larger props. It has 10 distinct colours against 14 for the bench-wood reference, and the repeated slats carry only light grain, so it reads a little simpler and more regular than the references. That is slightly lower in richness, but it is not shallow or flat-filled, and a careful artist would accept it next to the bench and hedge.
